title: CIFAR‑10 Image Classifier 📸
description: Build a convolutional neural network from scratch to classify CIFAR‑10 images with 85%+ accuracy.
problemStatement:
## 🎯 Objective

Design and train a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) on the CIFAR‑10 dataset. You will implement:

- A custom CNN architecture with convolutional, pooling, batch normalization, and dropout layers.
- Data loading with appropriate augmentations for training.
- A full training loop with validation, early stopping, and learning rate scheduling.
- Evaluation on the test set, aiming for **≥ 85% test accuracy**.

## 📂 Dataset

Use `torchvision.datasets.CIFAR10`. The dataset contains 60,000 32×32 colour images in 10 classes, with 50,000 training and 10,000 test images.

## 🧱 Architecture

Design a CNN that roughly follows this structure (you may modify within limits):

- Block 1: Conv2d(3→32, 3) + BN + ReLU + Conv2d(32→32, 3) + BN + ReLU + MaxPool(2)
- Block 2: Conv2d(32→64, 3) + BN + ReLU + Conv2d(64→64, 3) + BN + ReLU + MaxPool(2)
- Block 3: Conv2d(64→128, 3) + BN + ReLU + Conv2d(128→128, 3) + BN + ReLU + MaxPool(2)
- Classifier: AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1) → Flatten → Dropout(0.3) → Linear(128, 10)

You may use `nn.Sequential` for each block to keep the code clean.

## ⚙️ Training

- Split the original training set into 80% train / 20% validation (use a fixed random seed for reproducibility).
- Data augmentation (training only): RandomHorizontalFlip, RandomCrop(32, padding=4).
- Normalize with mean=(0.4914, 0.4822, 0.4465), std=(0.2470, 0.2435, 0.2616) (CIFAR‑10 statistics).
- Optimizer: SGD with momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, initial learning rate 0.1.
- Scheduler: ReduceLROnPlateau (factor=0.5, patience=3) monitoring validation loss.
- Loss: CrossEntropyLoss.
- Train for up to 100 epochs, with early stopping patience of 10.
- Save the checkpoint with the best validation accuracy.

## 📊 Evaluation

After training, load the best checkpoint and evaluate on the test set. Report test accuracy (formatted to two decimal places). Also print the total number of trainable parameters in your model.

## 🚀 Deliverables

Provide a Python script (or notebook) that, when executed, trains the model and prints:

```
Total parameters: <number>
Epoch 1/100 ...
...
Early stopping triggered at epoch <X>
Best test accuracy: <XX.XX>%
```
requirements: Use at least three convolutional blocks with increasing channels.
Implement training/validation split and data augmentation.
Apply ReduceLROnPlateau scheduler and early stopping.
Achieve test accuracy ≥ 85% (with proper tuning this is reachable).
Code must be self‑contained and runnable; set all random seeds for reproducibility.
hints: Compute CIFAR‑10 mean and std once and hardcode them – don't recalculate.
For early stopping, track validation loss; save the model state when it improves.
When loading the best model, use `model.load_state_dict(torch.load('best.pth'))`.
If you run out of GPU memory, reduce batch size or model complexity slightly.
expectedOutput: Console output showing training progress, early stopping, and final test accuracy >= 85.00%.
